section.title: Sec 1: The Lifesaver in Your Blood
lecture_lines: Red blood cells: most abundant, carry oxygen
Biconcave disk: plump edge, thin center
Shape increases surface area for gas exchange
animations: Animation step 1: Show a colorful blood vessel with red blood cells flowing. Label 'Red Blood Cells' in light red. Fade in text 'Carry Oxygen' in white.
Animation step 2: Zoom in on one red blood cell. Show a 3D-like biconcave disk (using 2D cross-section with indented center). Rotate it to reveal shape. Label 'Biconcave Disk' in yellow.
Animation step 3: Display a scale bar labeled '7-8 μm' in cyan. Show the cell next to a sphere of same diameter for comparison.

Animation step 4: Side-by-side comparison: sphere and biconcave disk. Highlight the biconcave disk with a glowing outline. Show a bar graph comparing surface area-to-volume ratio: biconcave bar higher than sphere. Label 'Higher Surface Area' in green.
